compte.title: My account
compte.empty: One account for the site, your courses and the Club.
compte.body: This page will bring together your spaces, your payments and your notifications. Meanwhile, each space opens from here.

methode.title: The method
methode.seoTitle: The method — learn by doing | Max-Morrys Edu
methode.seoDescription: You read before you pay, practise on your real project, your cohort reviews, and your certificate can be checked by code.
methode.lede: A simple method: you read before you pay, you practise on your real project, your cohort reviews, and your certificate can be verified.

steps.title: From the first lesson to the certificate.

read.title: You read before you pay
read.body: Free lessons in every course, no account needed. You judge for yourself.

practice.title: You practise, Rysmo IA supports you
practice.body: Every lesson ends with a mission on your real project. Rysmo IA answers about the open lesson.

cohort.title: Your cohort reviews, Max hosts
cohort.body: People who started the same month review your mission. One live session a month for your cohort.

cert.title: You get a verifiable certificate
cert.body: Issued once every lesson is validated server-side. Verifiable by code.

lesson.title: Under 12 minutes, one thing to do.
lesson.body1: Each lesson fits in a bus ride. The video's file size is shown before you play it, and you can keep it offline.
lesson.body2: What validates a lesson isn't having watched it: it's having done the mission.

text.title: The text
text.body: Readable without sound, in a few minutes.

mission.title: The mission
mission.body: One thing to do, on your project.

review.title: The review
review.body: By your cohort, if you want.

cohort.title: Your own pace. Never alone.
cohort.body: Your cohort is the people who started the same course the same month as you. You join if you want, you leave whenever you want.

ticks.live: Max hosts one live session a month for your cohort, with replay
ticks.progress: You see where the others are, with no ranking

cohort.legend: Where a cohort stands, module by module · orange is your module

mission.title: Mission or nothing
mission.body: A lesson is only validated once its mission is handed in.

review.title: Peer review
review.body: You review two missions, others review yours.

live.title: Cohort live
live.body: A monthly session, questions from your cohort.

rysmo.title: Rysmo IA alongside
rysmo.body: Your questions about the open lesson, quota visible.

offline.title: Offline
offline.body: Keep lessons on your phone, file size shown.

cert.title: Verifiable certificate
cert.body: A public code, no account, impossible to alter.

assistant.title: Rysmo IA, your assistant
assistant.seoTitle: Rysmo IA, the course assistant | Max-Morrys Edu
assistant.seoDescription: Rysmo IA answers about the lesson in front of you, at any hour. Your daily quota is shown before every question.
assistant.lede: It answers about the lesson in front of you, at any hour. Your daily quota is shown before every question.
assistant.demoHead: Rysmo IA · on the open lesson
assistant.demoQ: Here's my description: “Cheap, fast dry cleaning, Dakar.”
assistant.demoA: Too vague for a customer. Name your neighbourhood and what you do best: your turnaround, delivery, what sets you apart.

quota.title: A clear quota, shown upfront.

base.label: With your account
base.body: Included, on every lesson of your courses.

pack.label: Top-up pack
pack.body: Use them whenever you like. Packs and their prices are shown in your space, before any payment.

quota.reset: The quota resets every day at midnight, Dakar time.

missions.title: It doesn't do your missions
missions.body: It helps you do them, it doesn't hand them in for you.

validate.title: It doesn't validate a lesson
validate.body: Only the server validates, once your mission is handed in.

lesson.title: It stays on the lesson
lesson.body: It points you back to the lesson when the answer is already there.

memory.title: It doesn't remember without you
memory.body: Memory stays off until you turn it on.

agenda.title: Agenda
agenda.body: Dated Club sessions and events show up here. Cohort lives will be added as soon as they are scheduled.
agenda.bodyNoClub: Cohort lives and Club sessions will show up here as soon as they are dated.
agenda.remindersBody: Reminders before a live are not available yet. Your space notifications stay on.
agenda.clubHint: Club sessions show up here once you are a member.

cohorte.title: My cohort
cohorte.empty: No cohort is open for your course yet.
cohorte.body: Once it opens, each module will show how many members have reached it — everyone at their own pace, with no ranking and no names.
cohorte.liveNoneBody: The next live will show here with its date, time (GMT) and link as soon as it is scheduled.
cohorte.reviewBody: Missions handed in by your cohort will land here. Feedback = what works + one thing to change.
cohorte.myMissionsBody: The missions you hand in to your cohort and their feedback will show here.
cohorte.membersBody: Only people who have joined the cohort will appear here.
cohorte.rule1: We review the mission, not the person.
cohorte.rule2: Feedback = what works + one thing to change.
cohorte.rule3: What is said in a live stays in the cohort.

live.title: Cohort live
live.body: When a live is scheduled, you will find it in your agenda with its exact time (GMT), and the room will open here.
live.programBody: The running order is published with the live: welcome, reviews, your questions, the next mission.
live.reviewTitle: A mission reviewed in front of the cohort
live.reviewBody: Always with the person's consent. What works, one thing to change, and why.
live.questionsBody: Questions and chat open when a live is scheduled. The most upvoted go first.
live.askNote: The most upvoted questions go first.

missions.title: Missions and reviews
missions.empty: No mission to hand in for now.
missions.body: Every module ends with a mission on your real project. They show up here once you take a course.
missions.contentSoon: The brief for this mission is on its way.
missions.depositSoon: Handing in your mission from your space isn't open yet. Do it on your project, then complete it from the lesson.
missions.reviewsEmpty: No feedback yet. Peer reviews will open with cohorts: what works, plus one thing to change.
missions.turnBody: When your cohort hands in its missions, the ones to review will show up here.

quiz.title: Module quiz
quiz.body: A quiz opens here when the module you're taking has one. Your courses are under My courses.
quiz.question: Question {{n}} / {{total}}
quiz.pass: No mistakes. Save it in the lesson to complete the module.
quiz.passDone: No mistakes. This quiz is already completed in your course.
quiz.fail: You need every answer right to pass. You can retake it as often as you like.
quiz.rule: Getting every answer right completes the quiz. You can retake it as often as you like.
quiz.rysmoBody: Answer on your own first. Once the quiz is done, Rysmo AI can explain your mistakes on the lesson.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.body: Upcoming Club sessions, with their date and topic, will show here as soon as they are scheduled.

adhesion.title: Join the Club
adhesion.body: It will detail Club membership. The subscription is created from your space once signed in. Nothing is charged automatically.

defis.title: Challenges
defis.body: This week's challenge and your entries will appear here. No public ranking: consistency, not comparison.

live.title: Live session
live.body: When a Club session starts, it will open here. Upcoming ones are in the Club agenda.

profil.title: Member profile
profil.body: A member's profile will show what they chose to share. Reporting and blocking will be offered here.

publication.title: Post
publication.body: A feed post will open here with its comments. Go back to the feed to see the latest ones.

journal.title: Audit log
journal.empty: The log is not recorded yet.
journal.body: Every sensitive console action (role granted, quota reset, suspension) will leave a dated trace here with its reason. Nothing is shown until the log exists on the server.

roles.title: Roles and access
roles.empty: The roles table is not exposed yet.
roles.body: This screen will show what each role can reach, from the same table as the menu and the route guard. The real isolation stays in the security rules.

moderation.title: Club · moderation
moderation.body: Reports on posts, profiles and opportunities will arrive here, each with its context. Every action will require a written reason.

quotas.title: Rysmo · quotas
quotas.empty: Quotas are not recorded here yet.
quotas.body: This screen will show assistant usage by tier and let you reset a quota with a written reason.

infra.title: Infrastructure
infra.body: The status of Workers, storage and third-party services will show here once a probe records it. No light is on without a measurement.
